subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the existing prompt-send drop policy for aborted assistant tool-call turns, or should it preserve more interrupted context by synthesizing an explicit result instead?
rationale: Both choices are technically plausible: dropping prevents strict-provider rejection and avoids fabricated tool output, while synthesis may preserve more context but risks misleading the summarizer.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge the PR after normal gates, accepting small context loss for aborted turns to keep provider-bound compaction transcripts valid.

options.title: Require synthesis policy
options.body: Ask for a focused revision that preserves interrupted assistant context with explicit synthetic result semantics and matching tests.

options.title: Reject this repair shape
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want compaction to change aborted-turn handling without a broader session recovery design.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge the PR after normal gates, accepting small context loss for aborted turns to keep provider-bound compaction transcripts valid.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision turns on the session-transcript repair policy that steipete appears to have introduced and hardened historically.
